open_questions: Only CH_EFFECT_LINE exists in data/story_text.json; the other CH_* ids (CUT, SIZE, FX, RIVALS_LABEL) must be added to the source with English defaults from game/chains.gd before the Russian ones can load.

CH_FX_CYCLES is neutral ('на срок в циклах: {n}') because n varies and Russian numeral agreement cannot be done with one string. CH_FX_BATCHES has no placeholder in code (digit built in), so the Russian says 'Ещё одна партия за цикл'.
CH_CUT uses Latin 'tier' per owner decision 1 ('теряет tier'); frame assumed: 'компания {bot1} {cut} на рынке Military'.
handoff: story/ru/common.json holds 48 ids: all TUT_G* and TUT_GALAXY_* lines, CH_* fill-ins, CH_FX_*, EV_EFF_NO_RIVALS. Checks passed: placeholders, digits, length, Latin words. Ready to wire once the CH_* ids exist in the source.
